strengths: Reflect button border is now clearly visible (rgba(236,225,207,0.45), 13.5px font) — it reads as a real button over any sky, not a ghost
Log-tap hint now fires after the 2nd decision instead of the 3rd — catches the player while they still have short-term memory of the choice, much better timing
Cold-start 'Continuing House X' confirmation fires cleanly on re-entry, grounding the returning one-handed player immediately in their dynasty and generation
Pace pulse-dot is a smart liveness signal — the breathing amber dot tells a returning player 'years are moving' without words, and speeds to 1s on fast-forward
Fast-forward no longer resets on pause: pp.onclick does not touch fastFwd at all; pause and resume preserves the racing-years state exactly as expected
44px touch targets are consistently applied across footer buttons, slot delete, chronicle tabs, eulogy links, delete-confirm yes/no — nothing egregiously undertapped remains
Save code box is 13px DM Mono with user-select:all — one tap selects the full code on mobile, which is the critical friction-free moment for cross-device hand-off
The 'houses raised' section on the title screen gives a returning casual player an immediate emotional reward before they even start — mottos from past dynasties feel like trophies

improvements.why: Current padding (5px 13px) produces a ~27-30px tap target — the only remaining under-44px interactive element I can find. A one-handed thumb can easily miss it, especially sitting between the being line and the card area

improvements.what: Show a one-word pace label beside the flow text on mobile (e.g., a tiny 'fast' badge or arrow-double-right glyph when fastFwd is active)
improvements.why: The flow text changes from 'the years are passing' to 'the years are racing by' to signal the state, but on a quick glance the prose difference is subtle. A visual glyph (like '>>' or the amber color alone) would let a casual player confirm fast-forward is on without reading

improvements.what: Brief one-time tooltip or micro-hint that tapping the flow text controls pace (e.g., 'Tap the pace text to race ahead' as a hintOnce after the first time the player waits through 5 quiet years)
improvements.why: The pace control is genuinely undiscoverable on mobile — the aria-label is right but invisible; casual players who don't read code comments will never find the 3x speed-up without stumbling on it. The hint system already exists, this is just one more hintOnce call

verdict: The round-4 fixes land cleanly — every specific complaint from last round is genuinely resolved in the code, and this is now a polished one-handed mobile experience with only one lingering small tap-target gap on the reflect button.
